from pathlib import Path
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import re

report = Path('docs/performance/native-hook-body-proof-20261008.json')
data = json.loads(report.read_text())
source = Path('.local/tool-tasks/excess-star-hook-20261006/native-hook.cs')
lines = source.read_text().splitlines()
regions = []
for first, line in enumerate(lines):
    if not re.search(r'public static (?:async )?', line) or '(' not in line:
        continue
    opening = first
    while '{' not in lines[opening]:
        opening += 1
    depth = 0
    for last in range(opening, len(lines)):
        depth += lines[last].count('{') - lines[last].count('}')
        if depth == 0:
            break
    regions.append((first + 1, last + 1, '\n'.join(lines[first:last+1])))

review = []
for definition in data['nativeHookBodies']:
    if definition['Shape'] not in ['return-argument', 'return-int32-constant', 'empty-void']:
        continue
    name = definition['Method'].split('::')[1].split('(')[0]
    matching = [(first, last, text) for first, last, text in regions
                if re.search(r'\.' + name + r'\s*\(', text)]
    assert len(matching) == 1, (name, len(matching))
    first, last, text = matching[0]
    category = ('returned-current-accumulator' if definition['Shape'] == 'return-argument'
                else 'empty-mutation-body' if definition['Shape'] == 'empty-void'
                else 'false-mutation-indicator' if name.startswith('Try')
                else 'true-allow-vote' if definition['Instructions'][0]['OpCode'] == 'ldc.i4.1'
                else 'false-enable-vote')
    review.append({'modelDefinitionToken': definition['DefinitionToken'], 'modelMethod': definition['Method'],
                   'contribution': category, 'hookSourceFirstLine': first, 'hookSourceLastLine': last,
                   'wholeCallerHasCompletionDispatch': '.InvokeExecutionFinished(' in text,
                   'callerSource': text, 'isRuntimeCertificate': False})
assert len(review) == 68
native = json.loads(Path('.local/tool-tasks/native-hook-body-proof-20261008/native-caller-result.json').read_text())
assert native['gameMvid'] == data['game']['mvid'] and native['passed']
data['callerReview'] = {'source': str(source), 'sourceSha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                        'modelDefinitionCount': len(review),
                        'uniqueHookSourceBodies': len({x['hookSourceFirstLine'] for x in review}),
                        'contributionCounts': dict(collections.Counter(x['contribution'] for x in review)),
                        'rows': review,
                        'scope': 'Source-linked return/vote/mutation contribution only. Does not resolve patches, inherited events, enumeration/getter effects, operators or runtime/future closure; source parser is evidence collection, not a certifier.'}
data['nativeCallerBoundaryChecks'] = native
data['nativeCallerBoundaryChecks']['build'] = {'status': 'Passed', 'releaseSeconds': 2.06, 'warnings': 0, 'errors': 0}
data['nativeCallerBoundaryChecks']['syntheticInputs'] = {'runState': 'DispatchProxy permitting only IterateHookListeners',
    'receiver': 'uninitialized DefendSilent; reviewed default methods only',
    'map': 'null; default identity methods and completion dispatch only',
    'goldAmount': 2147483648, 'goldReachableInNormalBattleProved': False}
data['newOfflineNativeEntrypoints'] = 3
task = Path('.local/tool-tasks/native-hook-body-proof-20261008')
for name in ['NativeCallerFixture.csproj', 'NativeCallerFixture.cs', 'CollectCallerEvidence.py']:
    path = task / name
    data['sourceArchive'].append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'text': path.read_text()})
data['cleanup']['temporaryCallerFiles'] = ['NativeCallerFixture.csproj', 'NativeCallerFixture.cs', 'CollectCallerEvidence.py']
data['cleanup']['temporaryCallerBuilds'] = ['caller-build', 'caller-obj']
data['cleanup']['callerCleanupComplete'] = False
data['decision'] = 'Reuse body and caller-contribution evidence. Native caller checks refute whole-hook identity from a default identity method; no runtime certificate or pruning consumer is enabled.'
data['proofObligationsRemaining'][0] = '68 source-linked default contributions are recorded; enumeration, operators, default-completion events and patches are not thereby proved neutral. Native alias/event/conversion boundaries refute blanket whole-hook identity.'
data['gates']['documentation']['status'] = 'Pending after caller evidence was added'
report.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'callerModelDefinitions': 68, 'hookBodies': data['callerReview']['uniqueHookSourceBodies'],
                  'contributions': data['callerReview']['contributionCounts'], 'nativeEntrypoints': 3}))
